argument.reason: The ordered physical alphabet is the fixed complete list of thirty-eight symbols. All working slots are required exactly once by count, state/symbol domain checks and duplicate refusal; all halt slots are undefined. Symbols are mapped bijectively to integer IDs and all literal read/write/move/next values are preserved. Root genuine fixed Source/table provenance is separate from shape.

The palette compiler receives only the fixed complete machine and fixed zero/one/semicolon mapping. Program/public strings, band capacities and step horizon enter only its boundary construction. It always calls the full old generic palette; it never prunes by reachable states, target, width, seed, certificate, accepting trace or known proof.

Every top edge is pinned to an initializer-only color. The left frame starts PRE with no head. Complete fixed prefix pins exactly one head atL, all ordered headers/cursors and fixed data before CERT. The sole free interval can emit only bits until one semicolon, then blanks. ACTIVE cannot leave through a fixed tile, so missing semicolon is impossible; PAD crosses the first fixed suffix cell into POST. The right frame requires POST and exactly one head. All remaining suffix cells, fences andR are fixed. No initialization color is emitted south, so initialization cannot appear again below.

The fixed prefix/suffix are built in order with globalL/R only once. Each of sixteen fixed headers is followed by exactly one@^ and no other marked symbol. Payloads contain no header/sentinel/cursor. Raw# fences occur once perband; payload lengths are exact. All nonfree locations are pinned, including every postcolonB and fence. Positive tails are physically present, not a hidden layout predicate.

The adapter only checks literal machine declarations, binary carrier characters, exact integers and dimensions. It neither parses the program image/seed nor interprets public/postfix tags. An empty/semantically malformed pinned image remains a declared tiling instance whose actual parser takes a nonaccepting path. Certificate syntax, tagged values, exact public3/free2 root counts and request construction remain physical BOOT operations.

Shared pair colors force neighboring STEP triples to overlap on the identical complete cells; vertical cell colors carry the whole preceding/current configuration. With the unique initial head, the finite local update implements one deterministic unit TM step and cannot lose a head at a wall. Undefined or nonaccepting terminal heads have no next step. Pair colors and seen colors are disjoint, so a row cannot mix transitions with collection.

Left/right side run colors persist through every STEP row. Collection changes both to done, emits stop below every inner cell, and its seen chain starts0/ends1; only an exact accepting head changes0to1. An early collection cannot be followed by another row because no frame has north side done. The bottom pins therefore force exactly the declared number of STEP rows then one accepting collection row. This is a finite machine-history statement under the literal dependencies, not full mathematical checker refinement.

Every square tile has exact t-value1 only at its center; its four m-values lie at edge midpoints on one edge channel. Origins are all finite required even-coordinate centers and translations only. Distinct centers never overlap t; exact tiling chooses one tile at each required center. Adjacent tiles overlap m exactly at their common midpoint; equality is precisely Wang color matching. Exterior background midpoint pins impose the boundary; odd-odd corners carry no constraints. No geometric overlap/rotation test is used.

The returned finite board and all north/south/side m-pins define the search problem. They are not a tiled initialization row, a chosen certificate, a spacetime history or an acceptance witness. A future complete tiling would select free certificate symbols. Public program/theory/goal binding is to complete fixed literal wire data; external Source/image/native-domain/license attribution remains open.

Actual owners and current produced rows/cells/problem stay reachable in state/traceback. Bare raise preserves the exact primary, including foreign public-class or StopIteration faults. Root must check genuine firstfault before classifying component sentinels, retain raw traceback and run final custody. No full result or mathematical assertion can be reconstructed from an unfinished owner prefix.
